doc.title: John Heard interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995

title: Current playing and his LA band The Elders
summary: He plays enough, and leads a Los Angeles band, The Elders, with Tootie Heath, Herman Riley and Phil Wright.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Yeah. I have a band in LA called The Elders. You’ll be hearing about this band. Tootie Heath is in it, Herman Riley who works with Jimmy Smith at the moment, and Phil Wright, pianist. Herman plays reeds and Phil Wright, pianist, he’s an arranger and a composer and vocalist and all that stuff. We have a great little band in LA. You’ll be hearing about it.
